notes.title: Bug Fixes/Improvements V.1.1.4
notes.content:
You can now skip the credits, but not the two short cut scenes on the second level. That might be indefinite because the cut scenes are so short. Individual levels bug I thought would be fixed, but isn't. It will be soon. I'm also planning on adding a "Wipe Times" button.

Fixed a teleportation bug on Just climb and also fixed you being able to get out of the map on the third level.
